items.source_quote: N2 with backside power rail will be available in the second half of 2025 to customers with production in 2026.

items.statement: Mark（董事长）说熊本特殊制程厂2月24日举行开幕仪式，量产对准2024年四季度。
items.source_quote: We will hold an opening ceremony for this fab on February 24, next month, and volume production is on track for the fourth quarter of 2024.

items.statement: Mark（董事长）说亚利桑那第一厂4纳米量产对准2025年上半年，并相信质量和可靠性可以与台湾厂相同。
items.source_quote: We are well on track for volume production of N4 or 4-nanometer process technology in first half of '25 and are confident that once we begin operations, we will be able to deliver the same level of manufacturing quality and reliability in Arizona as from our fabs in Taiwan.

items.statement: Mark（董事长）说德国德累斯顿特殊制程厂计划2024年四季度开工。
items.source_quote: Fab construction is scheduled to begin in Q4 2024 this year.

items.metric_label: 下半年3纳米毛利率稀释
items.statement: 问答里Wendell（CFO）说，2024年下半年3纳米稀释毛利率是3到4个百分点，因为下半年量会明显大于上半年。这与准备发言里的全年3到4个百分点并列保留，都不是毛利率水平。
items.source_quote: So the second half impact from N3 dilution will be between 3 to 4 percentage points.

items.statement: Wendell（CFO）说更长期看，3纳米的毛利率稀释会逐步减小，因为未来几年盈利会继续改善。
items.source_quote: For the longer term, if you look at these 2 factors, our N3 dilution will gradually reduce, because the profitability will continue to improve or increase in the next several years.

items.statement: Wendell（CFO）说5纳米转3纳米对盈利是一次性的短期影响，中长期换来资本效率，好处大于短期一次性冲击。
items.source_quote: And N5 converted to N3, it's a onetime short-term impact on profitability, which will bring capital efficiency to us in the middle to long term.

items.statement: Wendell（CFO）说资本开支金额每年都会变，增速慢于过去三年。2024年资本密集度按他的计算大约是30%出头，此后数年维持在大约30%中段。
items.source_quote: And this year, if you do the math, is going to be mid-30s. We expect, in the next several years, it will remain around mid-30 percentage capital intensity.

items.statement: Wendell（CFO）说2024年高性能计算增长最高，而且明显高于公司整体；另外三个平台都会增长，但慢于公司整体。
items.source_quote: Krish, the HPC will be -- will have the highest growth, actually much higher than the corporate. The other 3 platforms will all grow, although slower than the corporate.

items.statement: C.C. Wei（CEO）说人工智能相关收入年复合增速大约50%；到2027年，很狭义的人工智能应用处理器占收入高十几，还没算网络和其他。
items.source_quote: But for TSMC, we look at ourself, the AI's a CAGR, that's the growth rate every year, it's about 50%. And we are confident that we can capture more opportunities in the future. So that's what we said that up to 2027, we are going to have high teens of the revenue from a very narrowly defined the AI application processor, not to mention about the networking, not to mention about all others, okay?

items.metric_label: 狭义人工智能收入上修
items.statement: 被确认高十几是否成立时，C.C. Wei（CEO）回答还可以更高。
items.source_quote: Or higher.

items.statement: C.C. Wei（CEO）说今年先进封装产出翻倍仍然不够，明年会继续增加。
items.source_quote: For example, this year, we are doubling our output, still not enough. And so we continue to increase for the next year.

items.statement: C.C. Wei（CEO）预计晶圆级封装、三维集成电路或系统整合芯片未来几年的复合增速至少超过50%。
items.source_quote: So we expect the growth rate for CoWoS for 3D IC or for SoIC per se, it will be more than 50% CAGR in the next few years, at least.

blocks.text: 2023年全球宏观偏弱，高通胀和高利率把半导体库存调整拖得更长。C.C. Wei（CEO）说，不含存储器的半导体产业全年大约下降2%，晶圆代工大约下降13%，台积电美元营收下降8.7%至690亿美元，新台币营收下降4.5%至2.16万亿元，公司仍跑赢代工行业。进入2024年，无晶圆厂库存已在2023年底回到更健康的水平，但宏观疲弱和地缘政治不确定还在，可能继续压制消费情绪和终端需求。董事长Mark把当前环境称为分裂的全球化：海外扩产同时看客户需要和必要的政府支持，用来提高客户信任、未来增长和全球人才。汇率不由公司控制。Wendell（CFO）把汇率列为2024年可能再影响利润的因素，但没有给出汇率对全年毛利率的点数。四季度末现金及有价证券为新台币1.7万亿元，公司同时口述相当于550亿美元，这是公司自己给出的对照，摘要不另做换算。

四季度需求已经从全年低谷往上走，但同比仍是下降年份的尾部。指标表第四季营收196.20亿美元，同比下降1.6%，环比上升13.5%。Wendell（CFO）口述的是新台币环比增14.4%、美元环比增13.6%，并把当季业务归因于3纳米持续放量。平台上，高性能计算环比增17%、占当季营收43%，手机增27%、同样占43%，汽车增13%、占5%；物联网降29%、占5%，消费电子降35%、只占2%。全年则是手机降8%、物联网降17%、消费电子降16%，高性能计算持平，汽车增15%；全年结构变成高性能计算43%、手机38%、物联网8%、汽车6%。C.C. Wei认为公司业务按同比已经触底。他给出的行业判断是，2024年不含存储器的半导体市场增长超过10%，晶圆代工大约增长20%，台积电有信心靠技术领先和更广的客户基础跑赢代工行业。第一季仍会先碰到手机淡季，一部分被高性能计算相关需求抵消。库存天数减少11天至85天，应收账款天数减少4天至31天，Wendell说主因是3纳米晶圆出货增加，说明出货在跟上，而不是库存重新堆积。

供给的主线是3纳米放量，而不是成熟制程去堆名义产能。四季度3纳米占晶圆收入15%，5纳米35%，7纳米17%，7纳米及更先进合计67%。全年3纳米只占晶圆收入6%，5纳米33%，7纳米19%，先进制程58%，高于2022年的53%。C.C. Wei说3纳米已在2023年下半年进入量产并强劲爬坡，N3E已在四季度量产；N3P和N3X会继续做增强。几乎所有智能手机和高性能计算创新者都在这个家族上合作，他预期这会是又一个量大、生命周期长的节点。2纳米采用纳米片晶体管，器件性能和良率按计划或超前，量产时程对准2025年，爬坡形态类似3纳米；背面供电版本更适合特定高性能计算，2025年下半年给客户、2026年生产。成熟节点今天大约占收入20%，16纳米及更先进大约70%，而且随着3纳米、2纳米占比上升，成熟节点占比还会下降。公司只和策略伙伴做有差异化的特殊制程，追求有客户负荷承诺的高良率有效产能。28纳米被看成嵌入式存储的甜点，并会把这类产能扩到海外。先进封装则是短板，今天的产能给不出现有客户，这种紧缺可能延续到明年。

技术对比集中在一家既是客户也是竞争对手的整合元件厂。C.C. Wei维持原先判断：对方最新技术与台积电N3P非常相似或相当；到2025年对方说要量产时，台积电该技术已是高量产的第三年。他不愿多评论客户的宣传，但强调技术成熟度、客户广度和几乎所有客户都在合作。Mark（董事长）补充，公司仍认为N3P与对方的18A相当，但整合元件厂通常为自己的产品优化，晶圆代工是为客户的产品优化；高功率服务器、手上的手机和大型边缘人工智能处理器并不是同一种需求，应该看客户的实际行动。对纳米片和极紫外光刻机，C.C. Wei说技术本身没有价值，只有服务到客户才有；公司会看工具成熟度、成本和进度，在合适时点做决定。到目前除一家以外，几乎所有客户都在2纳米上合作。成熟制程方面，他同意行业可能正在建太多产能，过剩担忧成立，但那是行业问题。台积电的有效产能有客户承诺，成熟节点盈利可以靠近公司平均毛利率，所以公司自己不担心。

四季度盈利被3纳米爬坡压住毛利率，又被经营杠杆托住营业利润率。指标表毛利率53.0%，没有同比百分点；Wendell（CFO）称环比下降1.3个百分点至53%，主因3纳米爬坡稀释，后文又以环比下降130个基点重述。指标表毛利103.99亿美元，电话会没有单列美元毛利。营业利润率41.6%，电话会称环比只降0.1个百分点，略高于原先指引，主因更高收入带来的经营杠杆；指标表营业利润81.62亿美元，同样没有同比百分点。每股收益采用指标表1.44美元，同比下降20.9%；电话会报的是新台币普通股9.21元。全年毛利率54.4%，电话会称下降5.2个百分点，主因整体利用率较低和3纳米爬坡，部分被更有利的汇率抵消；全年营业利润率42.6%，下降6.9个百分点，因为收入基数更低时仍在增加3纳米和2纳米研发。往2024年看，利用率回升是正面因素，3纳米收入占比升高会继续稀释，把部分5纳米设备转去支持3纳米会在近端增加成本和努力、换来中长期资本效率，汇率则不可控。剔除汇率并考虑全球制造后，长期毛利率仍看53%及以上。资本开支、经营现金流、自由现金流指标表都未单列。电话会称第四季经营现金约新台币3950亿元、资本开支新台币1700亿元，并派发新台币780亿元股息；全年资本开支口述304.5亿美元或新台币9500亿元，另一处说304亿美元，低于原先大约320亿美元。全年自由现金流只有新台币2920亿元。美元口径的第四季资本开支被写成新台币52.4亿元，单位互相矛盾，摘要不回填、不换算，也不用经营现金减去资本开支去估算自由现金流。现金股利的季度下限提高到每股新台币3.5元，2024年股东至少拿到每股新台币13.5元。

战略是继续做全球逻辑芯片最可信的技术和产能提供者，并用全球制造换取客户信任。日本熊本建设12纳米、16纳米以及22纳米、28纳米的特殊制程厂，开幕仪式在2月24日，量产对准2024年四季度。亚利桑那第一厂的厂务、公用工程和设备安装在推进，并与当地建筑工会签了培训、安全和本地雇佣的合作框架；4纳米量产对准2025年上半年，公司相信量产后质量与可靠性可以和台湾厂一样。德国德累斯顿与合资伙伴做汽车和工业特殊制程，厂房建设排在2024年四季度开工，与联邦、州、市政府的沟通仍然坚定。台湾在台南科学园区扩3纳米，并在新竹、高雄准备多阶段2纳米厂，台中的政府审批也在推进。海外厂初期成本高于台湾，Mark（董事长）说会管理和缩小差距，仍然承诺有盈利的增长。他同时宣布2024年6月股东会后退休，提名委员会建议C.C. Wei在当选后兼任董事长和首席执行官。人工智能被放进增长主线：模型训练和推理的计算量上升，客户更早介入，2纳米上的客户兴趣高于3纳米同期，手机和高性能计算都有。边缘设备的台数年增速只是低个位数，但神经处理器会提高硅含量。

items.question_summary: 某家既是客户也是竞争对手的整合元件厂称自己的性能、功耗、面积领先台积电2纳米，而且成本更低。公司如何看待这种差异，又如何为这类客户规划产能，以免过度扩张？
items.answer_summary:
C.C. Wei（CEO）：对方是客户，也是竞争对手。他维持上次的判断，对方最新技术与台积电N3P非常相似或相当，并说已经再核对过公开规格和晶体管技术。到2025年对方说要量产时，台积电已是高量产的第三年。他不愿多评论客户的说法，但强调技术领先还在，客户基础很广，几乎所有客户都在合作。被追问会不会因此积极扩产时，他说280亿至320亿美元会用于3纳米和2纳米产能。
Mark（董事长）：他补充，公司仍认为这一代与对方18A相当。整合元件厂通常为自己的产品优化，晶圆代工则是为客户的产品优化。高功率服务器、手机和大型边缘人工智能处理器的用法并不相同，应该看客户的实际行动。

new_numbers.meaning: 将用于3纳米和2纳米产能的资本开支
对方宣称最新技术量产时，台积电对应节点的成熟度

items.evasion_note: 技术对比给了与N3P相当的判断，总资本开支也说会用于3纳米和2纳米。没有说明会为这家客户单独准备多少产能，也明确说不想多评论对方的说法。
items.answer_quote: Let me repeat the last time when I comment on their technology. The comment stays the same, so that their newest technology will be very similar or equivalent to TSMC's N3P. We further checked again with all the specs, all the possible published in the technology, transistor technology and everything. My comment stays the same. With a big advantage in the technology maturity, because of in 2025, when they say that their newest technology will go on production, for TSMC, that will be the third year with a very high volume production in the fabs. So again, I don't want to make too much of a comment on my customers' claim. But let me assure you, we continue to have a technology leadership and we continue to have a broad base of customers. And almost everybody, almost, they are working with TSMC, okay?

items.question_summary: 生成式人工智能能不能让三星或英特尔补上技术差距、追上台积电？
items.answer_summary: Mark（董事长）：竞争对手当然在用人工智能，这不是秘密，但人工智能还在很早的阶段，去年11月才看到大型语言模型的起点，现在只看到冰山一角。他鼓励产业用人工智能加速科研，并说即便1纳米或更小很难，新的能力也在出现。竞争是公平的。他没有把生成式人工智能说成对手已经追上的理由。
items.evasion_note: 承认对手在用人工智能，并说还处在早期、竞争公平，但没有判断三星或英特尔能否因此追上技术差距。
items.answer_quote: whether our competitor are using AI, of course, of course, they use AI. And just look at all the company -- AI company in Silicon Valley or in U.S. That's not a secret. But on the other hand, AI is only in its nascent stage. Only last November, the first large language data is announced, ChatGPT announced. We only see the tip of the iceberg.

items.question_summary: 人工智能芯片里台积电能拿到的美元含量，占客户成本的比例低于手机。未来几年公司从人工智能拿到的美元会不会提高，增量来自前段制程还是先进封装？
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：收入来自前段和后段一起。今天看到的人工智能应用都来自台积电。数据中心里元件总价值的占比很小，半导体在整个系统里的占比也小。对公司而言，人工智能相关收入每年大约增长50%，到2027年，很狭义的人工智能应用处理器会占收入的高十几，还没算网络和其他。手机和个人电脑等边缘设备开始放入人工智能，台数年增速只是低个位数，但硅含量增加更重要。加总之后，相关应用对台积电是很大的增长。

new_numbers.meaning: 人工智能相关收入的年复合增速
到2027年狭义人工智能应用处理器占收入的比例
边缘设备台数的年复合增速

items.evasion_note: 没有给单颗芯片美元含量的提升速度，也没有拆前段和后段各自的占比。给了大约50%的年增速、到2027年狭义处理器占收入高十几，并说收入来自前段和后段一起。
items.answer_quote: But for TSMC, we look at ourself, the AI's a CAGR, that's the growth rate every year, it's about 50%. And we are confident that we can capture more opportunities in the future. So that's what we said that up to 2027, we are going to have high teens of the revenue from a very narrowly defined the AI application processor, not to mention about the networking, not to mention about all others, okay? And to further extend our value, actually, all the edge device, including smartphone, including the PC, they start to put the AI's application inside. They have some kind of a neural processor, for example, so the silicon content will be greatly increased. Although the unit is actually low single digit in CAGR, but the silicon content is more important. So put all together, if we lumpsum all the AI-related application, actually, it's quite a big amount for TSMC to grow.

items.question_summary: 进入纳米片和更先进节点后，公司对高数值孔径极紫外光刻机的选择和同业不同。决策看什么，优点和风险是什么，有多大把握？
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：技术本身没有价值，只有服务客户才有价值。公司会和客户一起给出最好的晶体管和最好的功耗效率，并且成本合理，更重要的是高量产时的成熟度。面对新结构和高数值孔径极紫外这类新工具，会看工具成熟度、成本和达成进度，在合适的时点做决定。到目前客户对进度满意。除了一家，几乎所有客户都在2纳米上与台积电合作。
items.evasion_note: 没有列出采用或不采用高数值孔径极紫外的具体优劣和时间表，只说明按客户、成熟度、成本和进度做决定，并称除一家外几乎都在合作2纳米。
items.answer_quote: Because of technology itself is no value. Only when that can serve your customer. So we always work with our customers to give them the best transistor technology and the best power-efficient technology and at a reasonable cost, okay? And more importantly, the technology maturity that -- in the high-volume production, that's all important. Everything. Everything counted together. So we -- every time we know that there are some new structure, new tools such as high-NA EUV, we look at it carefully, look at the maturity of the tools, look at the cost of the tools and look at the schedule of that -- how to achieve it. We always make the right decision at the right moment to serve our customers. And so far, all our customers are happy with TSMC's progress, okay? Did that answer your question. Almost everybody worked with TSMC on 2-nanometer, except 1.

items.question_summary: 线路不清。现场转述后能确认的问题是：上次说狭义服务器人工智能处理器五年后大约是收入的低十几，这次是否上修到高十几。
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：从去年第一季、ChatGPT变普及的三四月起，需求突然上升，客户要求同时准备前段和后段产能，所以才有信心说这块收入会增加。口径只缩到人工智能应用处理器。现在还早，但动能已经上来，他有信心数字还会增加，虽然不知道会增加多少。被确认是否就是高十几时，他回答还可以更高。

new_numbers.meaning: 五年后狭义人工智能应用处理器占收入的比例

items.answer_quote: The demand suddenly being increased since last -- I think, last year, the first quarter up to March or April, when ChatGPT become popular, so customers respond quickly and asked TSMC to prepare the capacity, both in front-end and the back-end. And that's why we have confidence that this AI's revenue will increase. We only narrowed down to the AI application processor, by the way. So we look at ours here, that we prepare the technology and the capacities in both our front-end and also back-end. And so we -- it's in the early stage so far today. We already see the increase, the momentum. And we expect -- if you guys continue to track this one, the number will increase. I have confidence to say that, although I don't know how much.

items.question_summary: 下行期毛利率已经高于过去。利用率回到接近满载后，毛利率能不能回到50%中高段？下半年因为产能转换造成的稀释，具体是什么，是不是一次性的？
items.answer_summary:
Wendell（CFO）：今年毛利率有两项负面因素。3纳米下半年的量比上半年大得多，下半年3纳米稀释是3到4个百分点；5纳米转3纳米也大多发生在下半年，影响1到2个百分点。更长期看，3纳米稀释会随盈利改善逐步减小。5纳米转3纳米是一次性的短期冲击，中长期换来更高的资本效率，好处大于一次性损失。产能按长期需求而不是短期周期来建，利用率可以较好。唯一控制不了的是汇率。综合起来，长期毛利率53%及以上仍然做得到。
C.C. Wei（CEO）：公司正在努力。去年很难，因为大家包括台积电都没做到原先的预测，利用率很差。他认为未来几年大家更有经验，台积电利用率会继续上升。
Mark（董事长）：公司正在做这件事，毛利率可以更高。

new_numbers.meaning: 2024年下半年3纳米对毛利率的稀释
2024年下半年5纳米转3纳米对毛利率的稀释
仍然维持的长期毛利率目标

items.evasion_note: 下半年两项稀释的点数和长期53%及以上说清楚了。利用率回到高位后毛利率能否到50%中高段，只说正在做、可以更高，没有确认分析师说的区间。
items.answer_quote: Right. Second half, the -- as I said, there are 2 negative factors affecting our gross margin this year. The first one is the N3 dilution. N3 volume will be much bigger in the second half than the first half. So the second half impact from N3 dilution will be between 3 to 4 percentage points. And also the N5 capacity converted to N3. That will mostly take place in the second half as well. So that will be 1 to 2 percentage points, okay? That's for this year. For the longer term, if you look at these 2 factors, our N3 dilution will gradually reduce, because the profitability will continue to improve or increase in the next several years.

items.question_summary: 既然对方的制程对自己的产品已经不错，未来两到三年这家整合元件厂的外包会继续增长，还是可能转回内部？
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：已经把对方自己做的可能性算进去了。这类产能规划取得很保守。策略细节不能再讲。
items.evasion_note: 只说已经把对方自己做的可能性算进产能、而且规划偏保守，并明确说策略不能再讲，没有回答未来两到三年外包会继续增长还是回流。
items.answer_quote: Actually, we have taken into account all the considerations, including the IDM, can do it by themselves. We have put that one into consideration, actually, in our capacity planning, actually, we took a very conservative way to prepare our capacity in this kind of a situation. Okay. I cannot speak more because of that's our strategy.

items.question_summary: 资本开支增速在放缓，今年中值大约持平。这是不是暂停，等2纳米上来后又会再升一波？
items.answer_summary: Wendell（CFO）：每年资本开支的美元金额都会变，要看具体情况。增速肯定比过去三年慢。换一个看法是资本密集度：过去三年的高点在2021年，超过50%，随后是47%和43%；今年按他的计算是30%出头，未来数年预期维持在大约30%中段。

new_numbers.meaning: 2021年起三年的资本密集度
2024年以及此后数年的资本密集度

items.evasion_note: 没有直接说2纳米会不会带来新一轮资本开支金额上升，改用资本密集度说明增速放缓、未来数年大约在30%中段。
items.answer_quote: Okay, Randy, the CapEx dollar amount, every year, may vary. It depends on the different situation. The rate of increase definitely is slower than the past 3 years. And if you look at -- I think the other way of looking at that is the capital intensity. In the past 3 years, the highest point is 2021. So it's going to be -- it was over 50% and then followed by 47% and 43%. And this year, if you do the math, is going to be mid-30s. We expect, in the next several years, it will remain around mid-30 percentage capital intensity.

items.question_summary: 市场在传日本第二座、甚至第三座厂。海外扩产的重心是不是从美国转到日本？
items.answer_summary: Mark（董事长）：日本第二座厂还在认真评估，尚未对外公布，仍在和日本政府讨论。技术仍会是7纳米，或16纳米、12纳米。他提醒高雄第一座厂原先是28纳米或7纳米，现在改成2纳米；如果日本有第二座厂，目前计划是这个方向。他没有说海外重心从美国转到日本。
items.evasion_note: 第二座厂尚未公布，技术方向说了7纳米或16纳米、12纳米，但没有宣布时间表，也没有回答海外重心是否从美国转向日本。
items.answer_quote: the second fab in Japan is in serious evaluation stage. We haven't announced to the public yet. And we're still discussing with the Japan government. Although many -- they are very cooperative, so we might be waiting for that. But that technology will still be either 7 or 16/12 technologies. And remember the -- our Kaohsiung fab, the first fab used to be 28-nanometer or 7-nanometer. Now it's becoming 2-nanometer. So that is the shift to -- for the -- if there is a second fab in Japan, that's our current plan.

items.question_summary: 亚利桑那5纳米略有推迟。按新计划，3纳米会不会仍在5纳米大约两年之后导入？
items.answer_summary: Mark（董事长）：第二座厂的厂房外壳在建，里面用什么技术还在讨论，也要看美国政府能给多少激励。按目前规划，时间至少要到2027年或2028年。海外厂实际导入什么技术，取决于当时当地的客户需求，没有一件是定案，公司会尽量让海外厂的价值最大。

new_numbers.meaning: 亚利桑那第二座厂目前规划的技术导入时间

items.evasion_note: 给出目前规划是2027年或2028年，但技术未定，并说海外厂最终导入什么要看当时客户需求，没有定案。
items.answer_quote: the second fab shell is under construction. But what technology in that shell is still under discussion, and I think that also has to do with how much incentives that fab -- the U.S. government can provide. And yes, there will be a gap, at least current planning is '27 or '28, yes. That will be the timeframe. To be honest, mostly -- most all the fab in overseas, what's actually being loaded, what technology being set up, really, it's a decision of customers' demand in that area at that timing, so nothing is definitive.

items.question_summary: 地缘政治下全球都在建成熟制程厂。长期会不会出现行业性过剩，台积电的成熟节点策略和盈利怎么看？
items.answer_summary:
C.C. Wei（CEO）：观察是对的，成熟节点现在可能建了太多产能，过剩的担忧成立。台积电增加的是有差异化的特殊制程产能，也就是有客户负荷承诺的有效产能，用来支撑未来业务。只要客户产品还有价值，公司认为自己没有问题。盈利会在公司平均毛利率附近，因此不担心。
Mark（董事长）：这是站在台积电的角度说的，行业本身可能有问题。
items.answer_quote: Laura, I think your observation is right. There might be too much of a capacity being built right now for mature nodes. So the concern on overcapacity is valid. Now let's talk about TSMC. As I said, the TSMC increased the mature node capacity for specialty technology, differentiated with others. We work with customers and that kind of capacity, actually, effective capacity as we name it, is with a commitment from customers' loading and for the future business. And because we offer the value for our customer to design their product, so we believe that they can retain their product's value even the capacity is flooded in the industry. And so long as our customer is doing well, TSMC is doing well. And so the profitability, as I said in my statement, it will be around the corporate average, so we don't have concern.

items.question_summary: 先进封装除了现有的晶圆级封装，三维集成电路和系统整合芯片进展如何，未来两到三年的产能和节奏是什么？明年呢？
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：需求很强，今天给不出足够产能，这种情况可能一直延续到明年，虽然正在努力扩产。今年产出翻倍仍然不够，明年会继续增加。先进封装已经投了十多年，晶圆级封装、三维集成电路或系统整合芯片未来几年的增速至少超过50%。需求在，关键是公司能不能提供足够产能。被问到明年的具体想法时，他说明年再谈。

new_numbers.meaning: 今年先进封装产出的增加，但仍然不够
未来几年晶圆级封装、三维集成电路或系统整合芯片的复合增速

items.evasion_note: 今年产出翻倍、未来几年复合增速至少超过50%说了，但明年的具体产能拒绝现在讲。
items.answer_quote: The demand actually is very strong. Today's situation, that we cannot offer enough capacity to support our customers, and that condition will continue probably all the way to next year, although we are very -- working very hard to increase the capacity. For example, this year, we are doubling our output, still not enough. And so we continue to increase for the next year.

items.question_summary: 现在主流是某一类晶圆级封装。客户有没有转向另外两种封装，对收入和毛利率有什么影响？
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：他先说自己甚至分不清那两种封装的名字。公司正在用足够的产能支持客户，虽然不是百分之百够，但会尽力。下一代封装方案客户反应非常热烈，公司正在为它准备产能。
items.evasion_note: 没有回答客户是否从现有主流封装转到另外两种，也没有讲对收入和毛利率的影响，只说在为下一代准备产能、目前仍不是百分之百够。
items.answer_quote: Well, let's make a joke. I even didn't know what is CoWoS-R or CoWoS-L. But anyway, we are working with customers to support them with adequate capacity, although it's not 100% enough, but we do our best. And we're developing that next-generation CoWoS-L or something like that for our customer. And it's overwhelming that it's welcomed by all my customers, so we are preparing the capacity for it.

items.question_summary: 在低至中20%的美元营收增速下，2024年全年毛利率怎么看？
items.answer_summary: Wendell（CFO）：今年毛利率有一些正反因素，下半年两项因素的稀释会更高。公司还没准备给全年毛利率指引，之后再谈。更长期把各项因素放在一起，53%及以上仍然有信心做到。
items.evasion_note: 明确说还没准备给出2024年全年毛利率指引，只重申长期53%及以上。
items.answer_quote: But we're not ready to give out a full year guidance on gross margin yet. So we'll talk about that as time goes by. But let me say this, longer term, with all the factors together, still 53% and higher is definitely, we're very confident in achieve that.

items.question_summary: 第四季高性能计算和手机大约各占营收43%。今年要达到低至中20%的增长，靠高性能计算还是手机？
items.answer_summary: Wendell（CFO）：高性能计算的增长会最高，而且明显高于公司整体。另外三个平台都会增长，但慢于公司整体。
items.answer_quote: Krish, the HPC will be -- will have the highest growth, actually much higher than the corporate. The other 3 platforms will all grow, although slower than the corporate.

items.question_summary: 会不会有美国客户只买美国制造的晶圆，使亚利桑那厂只服务美国客户？
items.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：亚利桑那厂是给所有客户的，但大部分是美国客户。
items.evasion_note: 说明亚利桑那厂面向所有客户、大部分是美国客户，但没有回答是否会有美国客户只买美国制造的晶圆。
items.answer_quote: Well, let me answer that question. Arizona fab is for everybody, but majority is a U.S. customer, you are right.

evasive_list.question_summary: 某家既是客户也是竞争对手的整合元件厂称自己的性能、功耗、面积领先台积电2纳米，而且成本更低。公司如何看待这种差异，又如何为这类客户规划产能，以免过度扩张？
evasive_list.answer_summary:
C.C. Wei（CEO）：对方是客户，也是竞争对手。他维持上次的判断，对方最新技术与台积电N3P非常相似或相当，并说已经再核对过公开规格和晶体管技术。到2025年对方说要量产时，台积电已是高量产的第三年。他不愿多评论客户的说法，但强调技术领先还在，客户基础很广，几乎所有客户都在合作。被追问会不会因此积极扩产时，他说280亿至320亿美元会用于3纳米和2纳米产能。
Mark（董事长）：他补充，公司仍认为这一代与对方18A相当。整合元件厂通常为自己的产品优化，晶圆代工则是为客户的产品优化。高功率服务器、手机和大型边缘人工智能处理器的用法并不相同，应该看客户的实际行动。

new_numbers.meaning: 将用于3纳米和2纳米产能的资本开支
对方宣称最新技术量产时，台积电对应节点的成熟度

evasive_list.evasion_note: 技术对比给了与N3P相当的判断，总资本开支也说会用于3纳米和2纳米。没有说明会为这家客户单独准备多少产能，也明确说不想多评论对方的说法。
evasive_list.answer_quote: Let me repeat the last time when I comment on their technology. The comment stays the same, so that their newest technology will be very similar or equivalent to TSMC's N3P. We further checked again with all the specs, all the possible published in the technology, transistor technology and everything. My comment stays the same. With a big advantage in the technology maturity, because of in 2025, when they say that their newest technology will go on production, for TSMC, that will be the third year with a very high volume production in the fabs. So again, I don't want to make too much of a comment on my customers' claim. But let me assure you, we continue to have a technology leadership and we continue to have a broad base of customers. And almost everybody, almost, they are working with TSMC, okay?

evasive_list.question_summary: 生成式人工智能能不能让三星或英特尔补上技术差距、追上台积电？
evasive_list.answer_summary: Mark（董事长）：竞争对手当然在用人工智能，这不是秘密，但人工智能还在很早的阶段，去年11月才看到大型语言模型的起点，现在只看到冰山一角。他鼓励产业用人工智能加速科研，并说即便1纳米或更小很难，新的能力也在出现。竞争是公平的。他没有把生成式人工智能说成对手已经追上的理由。
evasive_list.evasion_note: 承认对手在用人工智能，并说还处在早期、竞争公平，但没有判断三星或英特尔能否因此追上技术差距。
evasive_list.answer_quote: whether our competitor are using AI, of course, of course, they use AI. And just look at all the company -- AI company in Silicon Valley or in U.S. That's not a secret. But on the other hand, AI is only in its nascent stage. Only last November, the first large language data is announced, ChatGPT announced. We only see the tip of the iceberg.

evasive_list.question_summary: 人工智能芯片里台积电能拿到的美元含量，占客户成本的比例低于手机。未来几年公司从人工智能拿到的美元会不会提高，增量来自前段制程还是先进封装？
evasive_list.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：收入来自前段和后段一起。今天看到的人工智能应用都来自台积电。数据中心里元件总价值的占比很小，半导体在整个系统里的占比也小。对公司而言，人工智能相关收入每年大约增长50%，到2027年，很狭义的人工智能应用处理器会占收入的高十几，还没算网络和其他。手机和个人电脑等边缘设备开始放入人工智能，台数年增速只是低个位数，但硅含量增加更重要。加总之后，相关应用对台积电是很大的增长。

new_numbers.meaning: 人工智能相关收入的年复合增速
到2027年狭义人工智能应用处理器占收入的比例
边缘设备台数的年复合增速

evasive_list.evasion_note: 没有给单颗芯片美元含量的提升速度，也没有拆前段和后段各自的占比。给了大约50%的年增速、到2027年狭义处理器占收入高十几，并说收入来自前段和后段一起。
evasive_list.answer_quote: But for TSMC, we look at ourself, the AI's a CAGR, that's the growth rate every year, it's about 50%. And we are confident that we can capture more opportunities in the future. So that's what we said that up to 2027, we are going to have high teens of the revenue from a very narrowly defined the AI application processor, not to mention about the networking, not to mention about all others, okay? And to further extend our value, actually, all the edge device, including smartphone, including the PC, they start to put the AI's application inside. They have some kind of a neural processor, for example, so the silicon content will be greatly increased. Although the unit is actually low single digit in CAGR, but the silicon content is more important. So put all together, if we lumpsum all the AI-related application, actually, it's quite a big amount for TSMC to grow.

evasive_list.question_summary: 进入纳米片和更先进节点后，公司对高数值孔径极紫外光刻机的选择和同业不同。决策看什么，优点和风险是什么，有多大把握？
evasive_list.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：技术本身没有价值，只有服务客户才有价值。公司会和客户一起给出最好的晶体管和最好的功耗效率，并且成本合理，更重要的是高量产时的成熟度。面对新结构和高数值孔径极紫外这类新工具，会看工具成熟度、成本和达成进度，在合适的时点做决定。到目前客户对进度满意。除了一家，几乎所有客户都在2纳米上与台积电合作。
evasive_list.evasion_note: 没有列出采用或不采用高数值孔径极紫外的具体优劣和时间表，只说明按客户、成熟度、成本和进度做决定，并称除一家外几乎都在合作2纳米。
evasive_list.answer_quote: Because of technology itself is no value. Only when that can serve your customer. So we always work with our customers to give them the best transistor technology and the best power-efficient technology and at a reasonable cost, okay? And more importantly, the technology maturity that -- in the high-volume production, that's all important. Everything. Everything counted together. So we -- every time we know that there are some new structure, new tools such as high-NA EUV, we look at it carefully, look at the maturity of the tools, look at the cost of the tools and look at the schedule of that -- how to achieve it. We always make the right decision at the right moment to serve our customers. And so far, all our customers are happy with TSMC's progress, okay? Did that answer your question. Almost everybody worked with TSMC on 2-nanometer, except 1.

C.C. Wei（CEO）：公司正在努力。去年很难，因为大家包括台积电都没做到原先的预测，利用率很差。他认为未来几年大家更有经验，台积电利用率会继续上升。
Mark（董事长）：公司正在做这件事，毛利率可以更高。

new_numbers.meaning: 2024年下半年3纳米对毛利率的稀释
2024年下半年5纳米转3纳米对毛利率的稀释
仍然维持的长期毛利率目标

evasive_list.evasion_note: 下半年两项稀释的点数和长期53%及以上说清楚了。利用率回到高位后毛利率能否到50%中高段，只说正在做、可以更高，没有确认分析师说的区间。
evasive_list.answer_quote: Right. Second half, the -- as I said, there are 2 negative factors affecting our gross margin this year. The first one is the N3 dilution. N3 volume will be much bigger in the second half than the first half. So the second half impact from N3 dilution will be between 3 to 4 percentage points. And also the N5 capacity converted to N3. That will mostly take place in the second half as well. So that will be 1 to 2 percentage points, okay? That's for this year. For the longer term, if you look at these 2 factors, our N3 dilution will gradually reduce, because the profitability will continue to improve or increase in the next several years.

evasive_list.question_summary: 既然对方的制程对自己的产品已经不错，未来两到三年这家整合元件厂的外包会继续增长，还是可能转回内部？
evasive_list.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：已经把对方自己做的可能性算进去了。这类产能规划取得很保守。策略细节不能再讲。
evasive_list.evasion_note: 只说已经把对方自己做的可能性算进产能、而且规划偏保守，并明确说策略不能再讲，没有回答未来两到三年外包会继续增长还是回流。
evasive_list.answer_quote: Actually, we have taken into account all the considerations, including the IDM, can do it by themselves. We have put that one into consideration, actually, in our capacity planning, actually, we took a very conservative way to prepare our capacity in this kind of a situation. Okay. I cannot speak more because of that's our strategy.

evasive_list.question_summary: 资本开支增速在放缓，今年中值大约持平。这是不是暂停，等2纳米上来后又会再升一波？
evasive_list.answer_summary: Wendell（CFO）：每年资本开支的美元金额都会变，要看具体情况。增速肯定比过去三年慢。换一个看法是资本密集度：过去三年的高点在2021年，超过50%，随后是47%和43%；今年按他的计算是30%出头，未来数年预期维持在大约30%中段。

new_numbers.meaning: 2021年起三年的资本密集度
2024年以及此后数年的资本密集度

evasive_list.evasion_note: 没有直接说2纳米会不会带来新一轮资本开支金额上升，改用资本密集度说明增速放缓、未来数年大约在30%中段。
evasive_list.answer_quote: Okay, Randy, the CapEx dollar amount, every year, may vary. It depends on the different situation. The rate of increase definitely is slower than the past 3 years. And if you look at -- I think the other way of looking at that is the capital intensity. In the past 3 years, the highest point is 2021. So it's going to be -- it was over 50% and then followed by 47% and 43%. And this year, if you do the math, is going to be mid-30s. We expect, in the next several years, it will remain around mid-30 percentage capital intensity.

evasive_list.question_summary: 市场在传日本第二座、甚至第三座厂。海外扩产的重心是不是从美国转到日本？
evasive_list.answer_summary: Mark（董事长）：日本第二座厂还在认真评估，尚未对外公布，仍在和日本政府讨论。技术仍会是7纳米，或16纳米、12纳米。他提醒高雄第一座厂原先是28纳米或7纳米，现在改成2纳米；如果日本有第二座厂，目前计划是这个方向。他没有说海外重心从美国转到日本。
evasive_list.evasion_note: 第二座厂尚未公布，技术方向说了7纳米或16纳米、12纳米，但没有宣布时间表，也没有回答海外重心是否从美国转向日本。
evasive_list.answer_quote: the second fab in Japan is in serious evaluation stage. We haven't announced to the public yet. And we're still discussing with the Japan government. Although many -- they are very cooperative, so we might be waiting for that. But that technology will still be either 7 or 16/12 technologies. And remember the -- our Kaohsiung fab, the first fab used to be 28-nanometer or 7-nanometer. Now it's becoming 2-nanometer. So that is the shift to -- for the -- if there is a second fab in Japan, that's our current plan.

evasive_list.question_summary: 亚利桑那5纳米略有推迟。按新计划，3纳米会不会仍在5纳米大约两年之后导入？
evasive_list.answer_summary: Mark（董事长）：第二座厂的厂房外壳在建，里面用什么技术还在讨论，也要看美国政府能给多少激励。按目前规划，时间至少要到2027年或2028年。海外厂实际导入什么技术，取决于当时当地的客户需求，没有一件是定案，公司会尽量让海外厂的价值最大。

new_numbers.meaning: 亚利桑那第二座厂目前规划的技术导入时间

evasive_list.evasion_note: 给出目前规划是2027年或2028年，但技术未定，并说海外厂最终导入什么要看当时客户需求，没有定案。
evasive_list.answer_quote: the second fab shell is under construction. But what technology in that shell is still under discussion, and I think that also has to do with how much incentives that fab -- the U.S. government can provide. And yes, there will be a gap, at least current planning is '27 or '28, yes. That will be the timeframe. To be honest, mostly -- most all the fab in overseas, what's actually being loaded, what technology being set up, really, it's a decision of customers' demand in that area at that timing, so nothing is definitive.

evasive_list.question_summary: 先进封装除了现有的晶圆级封装，三维集成电路和系统整合芯片进展如何，未来两到三年的产能和节奏是什么？明年呢？
evasive_list.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：需求很强，今天给不出足够产能，这种情况可能一直延续到明年，虽然正在努力扩产。今年产出翻倍仍然不够，明年会继续增加。先进封装已经投了十多年，晶圆级封装、三维集成电路或系统整合芯片未来几年的增速至少超过50%。需求在，关键是公司能不能提供足够产能。被问到明年的具体想法时，他说明年再谈。

new_numbers.meaning: 今年先进封装产出的增加，但仍然不够
未来几年晶圆级封装、三维集成电路或系统整合芯片的复合增速

evasive_list.evasion_note: 今年产出翻倍、未来几年复合增速至少超过50%说了，但明年的具体产能拒绝现在讲。
evasive_list.answer_quote: The demand actually is very strong. Today's situation, that we cannot offer enough capacity to support our customers, and that condition will continue probably all the way to next year, although we are very -- working very hard to increase the capacity. For example, this year, we are doubling our output, still not enough. And so we continue to increase for the next year.

evasive_list.question_summary: 现在主流是某一类晶圆级封装。客户有没有转向另外两种封装，对收入和毛利率有什么影响？
evasive_list.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：他先说自己甚至分不清那两种封装的名字。公司正在用足够的产能支持客户，虽然不是百分之百够，但会尽力。下一代封装方案客户反应非常热烈，公司正在为它准备产能。
evasive_list.evasion_note: 没有回答客户是否从现有主流封装转到另外两种，也没有讲对收入和毛利率的影响，只说在为下一代准备产能、目前仍不是百分之百够。
evasive_list.answer_quote: Well, let's make a joke. I even didn't know what is CoWoS-R or CoWoS-L. But anyway, we are working with customers to support them with adequate capacity, although it's not 100% enough, but we do our best. And we're developing that next-generation CoWoS-L or something like that for our customer. And it's overwhelming that it's welcomed by all my customers, so we are preparing the capacity for it.

evasive_list.question_summary: 在低至中20%的美元营收增速下，2024年全年毛利率怎么看？
evasive_list.answer_summary: Wendell（CFO）：今年毛利率有一些正反因素，下半年两项因素的稀释会更高。公司还没准备给全年毛利率指引，之后再谈。更长期把各项因素放在一起，53%及以上仍然有信心做到。
evasive_list.evasion_note: 明确说还没准备给出2024年全年毛利率指引，只重申长期53%及以上。
evasive_list.answer_quote: But we're not ready to give out a full year guidance on gross margin yet. So we'll talk about that as time goes by. But let me say this, longer term, with all the factors together, still 53% and higher is definitely, we're very confident in achieve that.

evasive_list.question_summary: 会不会有美国客户只买美国制造的晶圆，使亚利桑那厂只服务美国客户？
evasive_list.answer_summary: C.C. Wei（CEO）：亚利桑那厂是给所有客户的，但大部分是美国客户。
evasive_list.evasion_note: 说明亚利桑那厂面向所有客户、大部分是美国客户，但没有回答是否会有美国客户只买美国制造的晶圆。
evasive_list.answer_quote: Well, let me answer that question. Arizona fab is for everybody, but majority is a U.S. customer, you are right.
